info.title: RiconRide API
info.description: Every Journey, Connected. Intercity bus booking, group charters and vehicle rentals in Ghana. Money is in Ghana Cedi (GH₵, max 2 decimals); phone numbers are Ghana mobiles (0XXXXXXXXX or +233…). Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json; validation errors list fields under `errors`.

get.description:
CMS. Every figure is a count or sum of real rows: gross volume (all time, today), seats booked today, fleet in transit, pending fare approvals, payments awaiting refund.

**Roles:** executive, system_admin.

post.description: Returns a bearer JWT and also sets the HttpOnly `rr_session` cookie (SameSite=Strict). 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (423).
Clears the session cookie. Bearer tokens simply expire.

get.description:
The signed-in operator's profile and role.

**Roles:** system_admin, dispatch_marshal, station_master, gate_marshal, fleet_manager, network_manager, communications, executive.
Public. Upcoming scheduled/boarding trips; `passengers` hides trips without enough free seats. Cities match case-insensitively.

post.description:
CMS. `departureTime` like `06:30 AM`, `duration` like `4h 30m`, `basePrice` in GH₵ (max 2 decimals).

**Roles:** dispatch_marshal, station_master, system_admin.

get.description: Public. Seat map shows occupancy only, never who sits where.

patch.description:
CMS. Partial update. Price changes apply to new bookings only. `status`: scheduled | boarding | departed | arrived.

**Roles:** dispatch_marshal, station_master, system_admin.

delete.description:
CMS. With no bookings the trip is deleted (204). With bookings it is cancelled, paid tickets become `refund_due` and passengers are notified (200).

**Roles:** dispatch_marshal, station_master, system_admin.

post.description: Public. Locks seats for 10 minutes for `sessionId`. Re-posting replaces that session's holds. 409 lists `unavailableSeats`.

Public. Creates a `pending_payment` booking and opens the payment; seats are released if unpaid after 15 minutes. Pass the `sessionId` used for hold-seat to convert held seats. `qrCodeData` stays null until paid.

get.description:
CMS. Filter by `status` (pending_payment | confirmed | boarded | expired | cancelled | refund_due), `tripId`, `date`; `search` matches booking number, passenger name or phone. Paged (`limit` max 100).

**Roles:** dispatch_marshal, station_master, gate_marshal, system_admin.

post.description: Public. Always 202 with the same message: boarding links go only to the phone by SMS/WhatsApp, so the response never reveals whether a number has tickets.

get.summary: Open a ticket from its link
get.description: Public. The `token` from the SMS/WhatsApp link is required; wrong tokens get 404.

patch.description:
CMS. `{id}` is the booking number or id. Send the scanned `qrCodeData` (signature verified) or no body for manual entry. Only confirmed tickets for today's departures.

**Roles:** gate_marshal, station_master, dispatch_marshal, system_admin.

post.description: Public. Created as `pending_approval`; dispatch sets the fare per person. Returns the invite code.

patch.description:
CMS. Sets fare per person, coach and notes. `status`: planning | confirmed | cancelled. The fare is locked once anyone has joined.

**Roles:** dispatch_marshal, system_admin.

example.dispatchNotes: Assigned executive shuttle. Fuel allowance and driver per diem covered.

get.summary: Look up a charter by invite code
get.description: Public. Status, pickup map link, approved fare, confirmed members and seats remaining. No member or organiser contact details.

post.description: Public. Only after fare approval. Reserves a place for 15 minutes pending payment; one active place per phone.

get.description: Public. Filters: `category` (SUV | Bus | Sedan | Pickup | Van), `driverOption` (self-drive | with-driver), `availability=available` with optional `startDate`/`endDate`. Vehicles with lapsed DVLA roadworthiness are never listed.

post.description:
CMS. Prices in GH₵. Images must be https URLs. Plate must be unique.

**Roles:** fleet_manager, system_admin.
Public. Price = full weeks at the weekly rate + remaining days at the daily rate (capped at a week), + driver fee per day, + refundable deposit. Self-drive needs `driverLicenseNumber`.

patch.description:
CMS. `action`: release | deduct | forfeit. The refund goes back through the gateway to the original payment method. A deposit can only be settled once.

**Roles:** fleet_manager, system_admin.

example.inspectionNotes: Returned with a quarter tank; no damage.

get.description: Public. Includes a Google Maps directions link and marshal contact.

post.description:
CMS. `id` defaults to `st-<slug of name>`.

**Roles:** network_manager, station_master, system_admin.

patch.description:
CMS. Partial update; inactive terminals can't be used for new trips.

**Roles:** network_manager, station_master, system_admin.

get.description: Public. Active banners inside their time window.

post.description:
CMS. `severity`: info | warning | critical.

**Roles:** communications, system_admin.

example.title: N1 diversion at Kasoa
example.message: Expect 30-minute delays on Accra–Cape Coast departures today.

example.question: Can I pay with Telecel Cash?
example.answer: Yes. MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money, Visa and Mastercard are accepted.

get.description: Public. Active operators. `rating` is null until a real review system exists.

post.description:
CMS. `id` defaults to `op-<slug of name>`. Rating is not writable.

**Roles:** network_manager, system_admin.

patch.description:
CMS. Deactivating stops new trips under it; existing trips are unaffected. The id cannot change.

**Roles:** network_manager, system_admin.

post.description: Public. `referenceType`: ticket | charter | rental; `referenceId` is the booking number, charter member id or rental number. The amount comes from the order; a different `amount` is rejected (422).
Paystack only. Verifies the HMAC-SHA512 `x-paystack-signature` over the raw body. Idempotent; a short or wrong-currency payment is flagged `refund_due`, never fulfilled.

get.description: Public. If still pending, asks the gateway directly (covers a missed webhook). Status: pending | paid | failed | refund_due.

post.summary: DEV ONLY: settle a mock payment
post.description: Exists only while no PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY is set. Simulates the customer approving the MoMo prompt.
